aether_dragon.description: When the wearer is sprinting, apply Speed II effect for 5s

fire_dragon.description: When the wearer is on fire, apply Fire Resistance I effect for 30s

dark_dragon.description: When it is night, apply Regeneration I effect for 10s

enchanted_dragon.description: Targets killed by the wearer drop 50% extra EXP

ender_dragon.description: When the health of wearer is less than 10, apply Resistance III effect for 30s and Strength II effect for 15s

forest_dragon.description: When the health of wearer is less than 10, apply Regeneration II effect for 10s

ice_dragon.description: When the wearer is hurt, deal 1 damage which also applies Slowness II effect for 10s to targets within 5 metres and knock them back

light_dragon.description: When it is day, apply Regeneration I effect for 10s

water_dragon.description: When the wearer is underwater, apply Water Breathing I effect for 30s

moonlight_dragon.description: Apply Night Vision I effect for 30s

tiers.description: The wearer takes reduced Sonic Boom damage
When the wearer is hit by a Sonic Boom, the wearer reflects Sonic Boom damage back to the attacker at 75% of the original damage

zombie_dragon.description: Apply Strength I effect for 15s at night

sunlight_dragon.description: When the hunger value of wearer is less than 6, apply Saturation I effect for 10s

nether_dragon.description: When the wearer is hurt, cause targets within 5 metres to catch fire for 10s and knock them back
